published_archive_date_source_identity: NCBI ClinVar tab_delimited archive maintenance-and-use documentation (https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/clinvar/docs/maintenance_use/) and the tab_delimited archive README (https://ftp.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pub/clinvar/tab_delimited/README) both state that monthly archive copies publish on the first Thursday of the month. 2026-08's first Thursday is 2026-08-06, matching this registration's own prior_head_observation.last_modified_date and stage_1_head_comparison.last_modified_must_equal pins above. This is a versioned, reviewed registration fact read from THIS spec file by raptor.eval.prospective_exact_source_metadata_lookups .published_archive_date_lookup, never a runtime fetch of NCBI's general documentation pages and never an inference from the live HTTP HEAD response (Last-Modified is transport metadata only -- see prior_head_observation.evidentiary_role above).
upstream_checksum_unavailable_reason: The authorized amendment-v2 metadata lookup returned HTTP 404 for variant_summary_2026-08.txt.gz.md5 before any archive body GET. The official NCBI archive index lists the monthly archive object but no adjacent checksum file or checksum manifest. The rolling tab_delimited directory publishes .md5 companions, but those identify later mutable rolling files and cannot authenticate this archived monthly object.
